boundaryRule.documentedFamily: A top-level capitalized MDX page in the pinned React Aria docs tree whose authored section is Components (or defaults to Components).
boundaryRule.familyPart: A non-root runtime export explicitly assigned to one documented family by the immutable family-runtime-export table in the evaluation tool.
boundaryRule.internalRuntimeSupport: Every value-bearing raw export not explicitly assigned to one documented family. It remains replaceable internal substrate support.
boundaryRule.internalTypeSupport: Every type-only raw export. It remains replaceable internal substrate support unless a later Core-owned public contract admits an independently authored type.
boundaryRule.rootNormalization: Toast maps to upstream UNSTABLE_Toast; all other family pages map to the same-named upstream root export.

nonGoals: No React Aria public API re-export
No React Native or framework-free counterpart
No implementation, package, dependency, Project, publication, or release mutation

trancheDerivation.rule: Eleven foundations/actions in R1.1; eleven field/form/date controls in R1.2; twenty-four collection/selection/color/virtualization families in R1.3; seven overlay/global/temporal families in R1.4; R1.5 implements no new family and closes the exact all-53 inventory, export manifest, support ledger, evidence, and prerelease boundary.
